latest_pose_prompt.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: static transparent two-pose batter atlas for a catcher-view baseball analysis scene. The LAST user supplied photograph of the white collegiate-uniform batter is the sole pose/camera reference; match its actual shoulder line, hands beside the face, bat above the rear shoulder, knee bend, foot placement and balanced ready-to-hit weight distribution. Do NOT invent a back-facing twist or rotate his torso further. Camera is directly behind home plate near catcher eye height, looking toward pitcher; batter stands beside the plate and looks toward pitcher, natural oblique view like the reference. Create one wide 2:1 transparent RGBA canvas containing exactly two separate full-body generic adult male batters: LEFT HALF a right-handed batter standing on screen left of the imaginary home plate, looking inward/right toward the pitcher; RIGHT HALF a separately posed anatomically correct left-handed batter standing on screen right, looking inward/left. Natural sports photo realism, consistent scale and lighting. Both wear unbranded navy blue helmets and jerseys, gray baseball pants, red batting gloves, navy socks, dark cleats, wood bat. Preserve the latest reference stance without copying identity, jersey lettering or logos. Each athlete and complete bat fits within its equal square half, generous transparent gutter, no crossing halfway. Center feet horizontally within each half, shoe soles aligned at 95% canvas height; complete bat and helmet within top 5% margin. Hands correctly stacked for their respective handedness, five fingers, natural elbows, no body twisting, no direct gaze at camera. This is two static independent illustrative poses, not an animation atlas and not a particular real player's mechanics. No stadium, no floor, no home plate, no shadow plane, no text, no labels, no checkerboard, no UI. Genuine fully transparent background.
